# secureaccess_network_object (Resource)

This resource manages a Network Object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_network_object" "example" {
  name        = "my_network_object"
  description = "This is my network object."
  type        = "network"
  value       = "192.168.1.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Network Object.
- `type` (String) Type of the Network Object.
  - Choices: `network`, `host`, `range`, `fqdn`
- `value` (String) Address of the Network Object.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Network Object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_network_object.example "<id>"
```
